stem.text: P, Q and R are carbonyl compounds.

stem.label: P
stem.alt: P, CH3COCH2CHO, displayed formula: a C=O ketone carbon with a CH3 group below, bonded to a CH2 above, which is bonded to a CHO aldehyde carbon with H below

stem.label: Q
stem.alt: Q, OHCCH2CHO, displayed formula: two aldehyde groups (C=O with H below each carbon) joined through a CH2 group above

stem.label: R
stem.alt: R, CH3COCH2COCH3, displayed formula: two C=O ketone carbons, each with a CH3 group below, joined through a CH2 group above
